newsitem.title: USA: Clinton FY '98 budget seen positive for NYC budget.
newsitem.headline: Clinton FY '98 budget seen positive for NYC budget.

text.p: President Clinton's proposed $1.7 trillion federal budget for fiscal 1998 would result in increases for various major New York City programs, according to a preliminary analysis by the city's Independent Budget Office released on Thursday.
"Federal grants constitute about 13 percent of New York City's budget, or over $4 billion a year," said Douglas Criscitell, director of the Independent Budget Office.

Some of the estimated funding levels for city programs include an $11 million increase, to $138 million, for the city's Head Start program, an incease of $21 million, to $445 million, for the Title 1 program, an increase of $6 million, or $32 million, for bilingual and immigration education, and a $15 million increase, to $536 million, for public housing operating funds.
